Catalan

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

gasto

  1. first-person singular present indicative of gastar

Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From German Gast.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɡasto/
  • Audio 1:(file)
  • Audio 2:(file)
  • Rhymes: -asto
  • Syllabification: gas‧to

Noun

[edit]

gasto (accusative singular gaston, plural gastoj, accusative plural gastojn)

  1. guest

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gastama (“hospitable”)
  • gastejo (“guest house; inn; tavern”)
  • gastiganto (“host”)

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasto”, in Plena Ilustrita Vortaro de Esperanto [Complete Illustrated Dictionary of Esperanto], 2020, →ISBN
  • “gasto”, in Reta Vortaro [Online Dictionary] (in Esperanto), 1997-2026

gasto

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɡas.tu/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɡas.tu/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ˈɡaʃ.tu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈɡas.to/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈɡaʃ.tu/

  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -astu, (Portugal, Rio de Janeiro) -aʃtu
  • Hyphenation: gas‧to

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from gastar.

Noun

[edit]

gasto m (plural gastos)

  1. expenditure, cost
  2. spending, expense

Etymology 2

[edit]

Participle

[edit]

gasto (short participle, feminine gasta, masculine plural gastos, feminine plural gastas)

  1. past participle of gastar

Etymology 3

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

gasto

  1. first-person singular present indicative of gastar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasto”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “gasto”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɡasto/ [ˈɡas.t̪o]
  • Rhymes: -asto
  • Syllabification: gas‧to

Etymology 1

[edit]

Partly Latin vastāre, partly from a Germanic language (compare English waste). Cognate with Portuguese gasto.

Noun

[edit]

gasto m (plural gastos)

  1. expenditure, cost
  2. spending, expense
Derived terms
[edit]
  • gastazo
  • gastito
  • gasto cardíaco
  • gasto deducible
  • gasto público
  • gasto social
  • gastón
  • gastos generales
  • gastoso
Related terms
[edit]
  • gastar
Descendants
[edit]
  • → Tagalog: gastos

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

gasto

  1. first-person singular present indicative of gastar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasto”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
